title: Camera keys ease in and out like every other key
goal: A camera push in or pan keyed at two moments has no way to ease: the Camera row at the top of the timeline offers no easing or curve on right-click, where every other key in the app does. A camera move should start and settle as smoothly as a title or a zoom can, chosen the same way.
notes: From the 2026-10-12 digest design review. Epic success item: any animatable value takes easing and bezier curves from right-click (objectives.json, video-transitions-motion). Audit 2026-10-12-camera-keys-row.json rough: the row has no curve view and no easing menu; right-click offers Go to Key, Show Camera Settings and Delete Key. Core: Sources/PhotonzCore/CameraRow.swift, SceneCamera.motions; app TimelineCameraRow.swift, EditorState+CameraRow.swift. One diamond stands for every camera value keyed at that moment, so an ease picked there applies to all of them; that is fine to start. If camera keys already carry easing somewhere else (the Camera section), reach that from the row rather than adding a second way.
acceptance: Right-clicking a diamond on the Camera row offers the same easing choices, and the same Curve row, as a key on a layer track
A camera push in keyed at 1s and 3s with Ease in out plays visibly slower at its ends than in its middle, measured on the renderer at three moments
Undo takes the easing change back in one step
A walk at Next defaults keys a camera move, picks an ease on the row, and photographs the panel and the row

log.note: 2026-10-14 digest: offer whichever easing list the-timeline-bar-easing-sets-picked-segments-too settles as the one a person sees, not a third list of the camera's own.
